video_title: Collin Sexton: Walker Kessler is Gonna Have a HUGE Impact on the Lakers - Mason & Ireland

quotes.speaker: Collin Sexton
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton on his motivation for joining the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I would say just opportunity to win, being on the big stage and being in the situation

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Mason
text_blocks.text: The news of you joining the Lakers broke very quickly after free agency began, which means those conversations were naturally having being taken place even earlier. What drew you about this opportunity with the Lakers?

text_blocks.speaker: Collin Sexton
text_blocks.text: I would say just opportunity to win, being on the big stage and being in the situation where I can try to come in and impact winning. I feel like being on different teams where it's been a lot tougher, of course the want to win it's always been there, but it's definitely tough to win. In the NBA it's a hard thing and each and every night we're playing against the best of the best. So, I think just being on this stage and being able to impact winning each and every day and what I bring to the team and bring to the game, I feel like I just fit right in.

quotes.speaker: Collin Sexton
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton on team building and Luka Doncic's leadership
quotes.excerpt: It was for us to to gel and work out together, not just in the states, just away

text_blocks.speaker: Andy Kamenetzky
text_blocks.text: Describe the trip to Ljubljana, the trip to Slovenia.

text_blocks.speaker: Collin Sexton
text_blocks.text: I would say it was one of those trips where it's more like team team building. It was for us to to gel and work out together, not just in the states, just away and also just the culture. Like for Luka to do that, that just shows a true leader and you can tell that's the role that he wants to fall into this season and be the one to lead us.

quotes.speaker: Collin Sexton
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton on the timeline for a new team to gel
quotes.excerpt: I would say some months. I would say some months for sure.
quotes.quote: I would say some months. I would say some months for sure, and I think that's one the biggest reasons that everyone was so happy that we was able to come together as soon as we did, just because we we all know in the NBA it's definitely hard to win, but it's also hard to put a whole new group of team together because you have different personalities, different different roles and different things for guys to fit in. So, I think us coming together early as we did, it definitely helped speed up the process.

quotes.speaker: Collin Sexton
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton on Walker Kessler's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: He's going to have a huge impact, especially on the defensive end, his presence, his rim protection

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Mason
text_blocks.text: You've actually played with Walker Kessler before in Utah and there there's a lot expected of Walker this year. What type of impact do you think he can have for this team?

text_blocks.speaker: Collin Sexton
text_blocks.text: He's going to have a huge impact, especially on the defensive end, his presence, his rim protection and even just his offensive ability that he's been working on this summer. I'm super excited for him and the opportunity and also just he's one of my guys. He's from Atlanta, so whenever I've been talking to him even when we wasn't on the same team I just told him like I got your back and then next thing you know we're here.

quotes.speaker: Collin Sexton
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton on his development and three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: The three-point shot, but also just finishing around the rim even better and a lot of false moves

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Mason
text_blocks.text: When you say the offensive stuff he's been working on, there's been chatter about him working on the three-point shot. Are you talking about that or other stuff?

text_blocks.speaker: Collin Sexton
text_blocks.text: The three-point shot, but also just finishing around the rim even better and a lot of false moves. So, it's cool. It's cool to see that he used that break where he wasn't playing all last season to really work on his game and develop it. So, I'm super excited for him and his growth and I can't wait to be back on the court with him.
